description: This file defines the 'KeyEntity' class which implements the 'ITableEntity' interface, representing an entity used in Azure Table Storage within the Orleans transaction system. It includes properties for sequence ID, metadata, partition and row keys, timestamp, and ETag, with a constant key value.

classes.name: KeyEntity
classes.description: Represents a table entity for key management in transaction storage.

methods.name: KeyEntity (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of KeyEntity, setting the RowKey to a constant value.
